Technical Manual
:::

## What this task achieves

Use this route to prepare one authorised Windows 11 workstation for BNR
analysis, website editing and publication.

## Before you start

- Confirm the person, computer and required access are authorised.
- Have the GitHub, REDCap and Stata access details available.
- Know where the separate public repository and private workspace will be kept.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Procedure at a glance"}
Confirm access → understand the public/private boundary → install and configure
the workstation → verify the complete setup.
:::

## Complete the following steps

| Order | Manual | Task | Detailed guidance |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Operations]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--operations} | **Confirm authorised responsibility and access** — named BNR role; appropriate accounts; approved computer; public and private information kept separate | Check [Roles and decision rights](../../operations/operating-model/roles-decision-rights.qmd#core-roles). |
| 2 | [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Understand where each part of the system belongs** — Stata; Python; Quarto; Git; GitHub; public repository; private workspace | Read [The BNR Info-Hub analytics and publishing environment](../getting-started/environment.qmd). |
| 3 | [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Install, configure and verify the complete workstation** — supporting software; repository; private workspace; local paths; REDCap access; Python; Stata profile; Quarto preview; setup record | Follow [Set up a BNR workstation](../getting-started/workstation-setup.qmd) from Stage 1 through the final verification. |

## How to confirm completion

The final workstation checks pass, Stata can see the BNR menu and configured
paths, and `start-info-hub-edit.bat` opens the local website preview.
